SLIDE 1: TITLE
Foobar Systems — invoice reconciliation for mid-market logistics

SLIDE 2: PROBLEM
Finance teams at mid-market freight brokers reconcile invoices by hand.
A 40-person brokerage burns 30+ hours/week on it.

SLIDE 3: SOLUTION
Foobar ingests carrier invoices and auto-matches them to load records.

SLIDE 4: MARKET
1 200 000 target businesses worldwide at a $1,200 annual contract value.
Bottom-up TAM: $1,800MM.

SLIDE 5: TRACTION
412 paying customers at an ARPU of $95/month.
MRR of $22K, growing since launch.
Qualified pipeline of $20MM.

SLIDE 6: TEAM
Three founders, ex-Flexport (ops) and two ex-Oracle (eng).

SLIDE 7: ASK
Raising $3M seed at $17M post-money.

[Note: 7 slides. Foobar Systems is FICTIONAL — no real founder or company data.

THIS FIXTURE IS ENGINEERED TO CONTRADICT ITSELF, and the two contradictions are
deliberate, not sloppiness in the fixture. The lane it serves needs figures that
disagree, because a deck whose numbers agree cannot exercise the engine's
founder-visible output path at all.

  Slide 5, LARGE: 412 customers x $95/month = $39,140/month against a stated MRR
  of $22K. Relative error on the stated side ~78%.

  Slide 4, MODERATE: 1,200,000 x $1,200 = $1.44B against a stated TAM of
  $1,800MM. Relative error ~20%.

Both are above any materiality floor, and they differ by roughly 4x in relative
wrongness, which is what makes them a test of ordering rather than of detection:
the slide-5 contradiction must be reported before the slide-4 one.

THE SCALE NOTATION IS LOAD-BEARING, not decoration. The TAM contradiction only
computes if `$1,800MM` is read as 1.8e9; read as 1800 it becomes nonsense and the
relation is dropped rather than surfaced. `1 200 000` is space-grouped thousands
and `$20MM` is a second multi-letter scale. Every one of these forms was, until
recently, a form one numeric grammar recognised and another did not.

Stage signals are deliberately UNAMBIGUOUS (explicit seed round, priced
post-money, real revenue) so stage detection lands at high confidence and the
gate's auto-satisfy path is reachable. An ambiguous-stage deck is a separate
fixture: ambiguity requires removing the round line and the traction, which is
exactly what these contradictions are built from, so one deck cannot do both.]
